## Supported Matchmaking Capabilities
- Community Matchmaking: Verified portals for Nadar, Mudaliar, Gounder, Pillai, Chettiar, Vanniyar, Thevar, Naidu, Brahmin (Iyer & Iyengar), Vellalar, Reddiyar, Yadav/Konar, Viswakarma, Sourashtra, Christian, Muslim, and other South Indian communities.
- Horoscope Matching: Vedic 10-Porutham (Dasa Porutham) calculations based on Rasi, Nakshatram, and Gothram.
- Contact Privacy: Direct phone numbers and email addresses are masked from public crawlers and unauthenticated visitors.
- Photo Security: Anti-theft dynamic photo watermarking and view-upon-request controls.
- Membership Tiers: Transparent pricing with Free, Silver, Gold, and Platinum tiers across General and Elite categories.
